requirements.text: 3+ years of experience in software engineering or quality engineering with robust Java development expertise.

Paramount Skydance Corp. is seeking a Software Engineer in Test to design, architect, and deliver high-quality, scalable, and reliable automated testing solutions across our enterprise platforms. This role requires robust Java engineering skills and knowledge of advanced test automation. It also needs experience in the media and streaming domain. The goal is to improve quality, reduce risk, and provide top-notch customer experiences on CTV, SmartTV, mobile, and web platforms.
Demonstrated experience using and enhancing an existing enterprise/departmental automation framework (not building entirely new frameworks).
Deep expertise in common test automation tools (Selenium, Appium, Playwright, REST-Assured, TestNG, JUnit, Maven/Gradle).
AI experience (must-have): hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot (IDE), Cursor or similar.
Solid knowledge of software design patterns, data structures, and core engineering principles.
